description: Several large, colorful LEGO-style blocks are spread out on the bed in front of the hands, with a pink pillow propped up at the back. The left hand pulls a white block to the center and steadies it while the right hand brings a blue block onto it, then the right hand slides a purple block in beside the stack and adds a green block and a yellow block to build up a small layered structure as the left hand briefly helps align and press pieces together before releasing.
